summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for StudyFlow covering:
- Draggable and reorderable dashboard widgets (mouse and touch compatible)
- Editable Pomodoro timer with inline custom minutes and quick presets (15, 25, 45, 60 min)
- Fix for 'Generate Cards' button and category creation warning modal
- Google Calendar integration with readonly scope, monthly caching, and timeline view
- Time-gated calendar event completion contributing to daily study streaks
- Comprehensive Google Drive auto-sync on every state change
- Live Online / Offline network status badge in header
- Soft, modern, eye-friendly theme with warm soothing backgrounds and gentle shadows
